name: White Nights
source:
In White Nights the story is that of a dreamer, set in nineteenth century Saint Petersbug, in Russia. A melancholic tale on the backdrop of the most romantic event of the city – the white nights.

[from the [url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]official site[/url]]

This is a visual novel adaptation of Fyodor Mikhailovich Dostoyevsky's original short story.
translation:
《白夜》的故事发生在十九世纪的俄罗斯圣彼得堡，讲述了一个梦想家的故事。这是一个以这座城市最浪漫的事件——白夜为背景的忧郁故事。

[来自[url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]官方网站[/url]]

这是费奥多尔·米哈伊洛维奇·陀思妥耶夫斯基原创短篇小说改编的视觉小说。
